name: Screen Protective Film w/ High Transparency Finish for Motorola Atrix
description: Protect the screen on your Motorola Atrix from scratches and fingermarks with a Monoprice protective screen film. This screen protector is sized to perfectly fit your Motorola Atrix and comes with a High Transparency finish, which allows the full spectrum of colors to shine through in all their original glory. While the film will adhere to the screen, it will not leave any resins or residue when removed. The packaging includes a lint-free cleaning cloth, to ensure that the screen is clean before applying the film, and an installation card, to help remove any small air bubbles that may occur during application. Motorola Atrix not included! Get the most out of your Motorola Atrix with Monoprice accessories!
